description.Description: Natural-language description of the image, generated by a large language model (claude-opus-4-8) from the image content.

NSD_id.Description: Numeric image identifier in the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) shared1000 set. The images derive from the Microsoft COCO dataset and are not redistributed here (present: false); see https://naturalscenesdataset.org for access. HED annotations were generated from the descriptions via the HEDit tool and quality-controlled against the HED schema.
